source_refs.title: Use caller ID & spam protection - Phone app Help
source_refs.section: Turn caller ID & spam protection off or back on (Filter spam calls)
source_refs.applicability: Pixel; Phone app; the Filter spam calls option depends on whether the device has automatic Call Screen
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To block spam calls on your phone, turn on Filter spam calls.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Pixel: Open the Phone app. Tap More options, then Settings, then Caller ID and spam. Optional: To block spam calls, turn on Filter spam calls. Filtered calls don't trigger missed call or voicemail notifications, but they appear in your call history, and you can check your voicemail. If your device has an automatic Call Screen feature, there is no Filter spam calls option. Spam autoblocking is one of the automatic Call Screen options instead.
